environment.description: Deployed behind AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes a custom rate-based rule (threshold: 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP on URI path /api/v2/webhooks/*) combined with a custom rule group containing a regex pattern rule that inspects response bodies from the /api/v2/webhooks/result/* path. The response body inspection rule uses a JsonBody match scope targeting $.result.code with an exact string match on 'PADDING_ERROR' and action BLOCK with custom response code 403. Additionally, an AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet is enabled in COUNT mode for telemetry. The ALB access logs are shipped to CloudWatch but no automated remediation is configured on them.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL association

waf_rules.name: ResponseInspection-PaddingOracle
waf_rules.note: WAFv2 response inspection feature (2023) blocks responses containing oracle signal

config.network: Private subnet, ALB in public subnet
